speaker: margery_pell
text: Two-thirds of Thursday, Master Shakespeare, and louder, if you call louder a kindness. I am not giving you a sum. A sum is Heminges's, when there is a Saturday. I have a stair and a noise.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two-thirds, and louder. I will take the size and leave the money. What did they shout before I was ready for them?

speaker: will_kemp
text: Remuneration! They had it before the line. I had not opened my mouth, and the yard was already paying me in my own word. You heard it. Do not tell me you were thinking of a cut.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard it. I was in the paper crown, and the crown does not stop a man's ears. They wanted the word. They did not wait for Costard to spend it.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: And the long Latin word, Master Kemp. The gallery had it with you, not after you. I ticked what you added. I did not tick a chant I cannot spell on a margin without looking a fool.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Let them have the long word. I am not your schoolmaster, and you are not mine. They laughed at my lines, Will. I counted.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: How many did you count, since you counted?

speaker: will_kemp
text: Thirteen. Today. Not a song. A song is a different boast, and I am not making it in a parlour to a man with a pin. Thirteen lines the book did not have when you handed it over.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Thirteen today. Eleven on Thursday. Twenty-four in two days. At this rate he will owe us a scene by Easter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twenty-four is the tally. Easter is not a promise. You will not grow it by wishing, Will, and I will not shrink it because a margin makes me vain.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The hush on the messenger. That was not an accident. Thou stoodst in the paper crown and heardst a yard go quiet on purpose. Do not tell me afterwards that the quiet was luck.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It was not luck. I left the half-line where it was, and Sincler did not help it, and the yard did the rest. I heard it clean. I have heard safer passages lose to an inn's noise. This one did not.

speaker: margery_pell
text: The stair went quiet with them. I do not like a quiet stair as a rule. I liked that one. It was about the length of a breath, and then they remembered they had paid.

speaker: will_kemp
text: And when they drifted, in the yard, toward the gate and somebody's business that was not ours, I fetched them back. I did not break the scene to do it. You saw me do it. You do not get to call it a rescue and then disown the lines that did the fetching.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I saw you fetch them. I own it. The book did not have those lines at noon. The yard had them by the end, and the yard came back. That is yours, and it is also mine, because I am the man who has to keep them or strike them, and I am not striking a thing that worked.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Then they stand in the margin as thirteen, and they do not stand as a song. I have the pin. I have no note of a tune. If a tune appears by Saturday I will say so. It has not appeared.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The ending. Did it work? I am asking the man who wrote it, and I am not asking him what he hoped.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The yard laughed where I thought they might go tender, and they went quiet where I had left room for a laugh. What I meant is not what they did. What they did is the news. Berowne can trust that. I would not rewrite the last page tonight to make my meaning louder than their noise.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Good. Thou wilt leave it. I rode the rhymes I trust, and I am not taking a midnight improvement for my pains.

speaker: (the lawyer)
text: Who made the play? I ask at the door, since no one has thought to print it on the bill. A man likes to know whose Latin he has been shouting.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have your answer, sir, and it is a thumb. The bill is the title. The title was enough for the yard. It can be enough for the parlour door.

speaker: (the lawyer)
text: A thumb is an odd author. I will spend it in Gray's Inn as a fact. They are already spending the long word.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Let him spend it on the stair, not in my box. Off the door, sir. The playing is done, and the door is for men who are leaving.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Before you go up, Master Will, there is a word from Holywell. Richard's father wants you at the Theatre in the morning, at ten of the clock, on the north side. Not at nine in this yard. He was particular, and he was not polite about the particular.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Ten of the clock, at the Theatre. Not nine here. I have it. If he wants a post looked at, he can say so in the morning, on the ground. I am not buying a repair in a tiring-parlour.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Go and look at his post. You will not find thirteen lines in a rotten beam, and you will not find a song either. You may write that I can leave a scene once I have won it. You may not write that I was quiet out of modesty.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will write twenty-four, if I write anything. I will not write a song. You have not given me one. Dick, the ending stands as the yard played it. Abel, shut the margin on thirteen. Margery, I will not ask you for a sum you have already refused.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Two-thirds, and louder. That is the sum I have. Take it up to Bishopsgate with you, and do not turn it into pounds on the way.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou hast the morning, then. My father at ten. I will not come and interpret him. He interprets himself, at length, and mostly about timber.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Twenty-four in two days. I will say it once more, so nobody goes home with eleven still in his head. Eleven was Thursday. Thursday is over.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Eleven is over. Twenty-four is the tally. Easter can wait until Easter. I am going home with a horn that is still full, and a crown that has survived an afternoon, and no new promise to my wife.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Full horns and paper crowns. You live like a king who has read a book. Get along. If you strike my thirteen before Saturday, say it to my face, and say it with a better joke than the beam.
